title: Accelerated demo visuals & enterprise quickstart asset pack
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Create a focused asset pack of annotated product screenshots and slide-ready visuals tailored for sales/solution quickstarts. Deliverables target three demo personas (self-serve developer, platform engineer on Dedicated, and security/compliance buyer for Private) and include annotated overlays, localized copy variants, 16:9 slide exports, and high-resolution images for printed one-pagers.
tasks: Capture controlled screenshots for hosted API flows (chat, embeddings, streaming) in latest console build
Capture screenshots for Dedicated capacity UI: capacity pools, autoscaling policy modal, and rollout config
Capture Private deployment screens: VPC setup wizard, KMS integration UI, audit log view
Design annotated overlays: callouts, step numbers, key metric highlights (latency/cost breakdown)
Create two visual themes: Rain (brand primary) and Neutral (enterprise-safe gray palette) for A/B in slides
Produce localized text overlays (EN/FR/DE) for top-level slides
Generate export set: 1920x1080 PNGs, 3840x2160 print TIFFs, and SVG UI components where applicable
Prepare low-bandwidth compressed variants for email and CMS
Accessibility: add alt-text for each visual and flag color-contrast issues
Assemble final Figma file and prepare Drive asset folder with README and export spec
acceptance_criteria: A complete export pack exists in Drive with 1920x1080 and 3840x2160 variants for each screenshot
Figma file contains annotated layers (callouts and alt-text notes) and two visual themes
Sales team has reviewed and approved the demo sequence for three personas
All screenshots are scrubbed of customer-specific data and tokens
Localization overlays for EN/FR/DE provided and spot-checked
Accessibility checklist completed and any contrast issues remediated or documented
